Trash Party

Play in
Browser

The Trash Party demo, right here in your browser. Free, no install. Rooms are cross-platform: share your room code and friends on Steam can join you.

First load downloads about 110 MB. After that it opens from cache.

Open in a new tab (opens in a new tab) Wishlist Now (opens in a new tab)

Before you play

  • Use a computer with Chrome, Edge or Firefox. Phones and tablets are not supported.
  • Controllers work: plug one in and press a button once the game is open.
  • Liked it? Wishlist Trash Party on Steam to hear when the full game comes out.
